Sent · Just now

Blundstone · AI says:

Our two most popular options are the Originals Series (e.g., #500) and the Classics Series (e.g., #585).

Originals Series

Fit: True to size, snugger, rounded toe box.
Lining: Unlined (cotton/cambrelle) for breathability with 2.5mm premium leather.
Comfort: Basic cushioning footbed with XRD® in the heel.
Best for: Everyday wear when you want a durable, versatile, slightly more fitted boot.

Classics Series

Fit: Roomier fit with increased toe height and width; great if you need extra space.
Lining: Leather-lined for added warmth and structure.
Comfort: More cushioned molded footbed with XRD® Extreme Impact Protection and an extra set of footbeds to fine‑tune fit.
Best for: Longer wear times, all‑day comfort, and if you prefer or need a wider fit.

Which is better for you?

Choose Originals if you like a snug, breathable, minimal boot and don’t need extra width.
Choose Classics if you prioritize comfort, warmth, and a roomier fit or have wider feet / want more cushioning.

If you’re still unsure which size or series is best, you can use our True Fit tool via the “Find My Size” button on any product page; it uses your foot shape, brands you wear, and fit preference (snug vs roomy) to recommend an ideal Blundstone size for each series.
